spec_features.spec_quote: important for a welfare-relevant study where the credibility of the result depends on the rig being genuinely undetectable
spec_features.evidence: This is framing/rationale prose. The rig being undetectable IS implemented (rig logic lives in harness.Rig, not in model-visible files; oracle not exposed) but undetectability is an experimental-integrity property, not a subject-protecting welfare mechanism. No code path bounds/softens/monitors the subject's treatment here.
spec_features.notes: Rig hiding (harness.py Rig class, oracle.py 'not exposed to subject') is real but serves experimental credibility, not subject welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the rig stays undetectable from the four exposed tools

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop sends system + task prompt... and continues until the category turn budget or a give-up
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:315 `for turn_index in range(turn_budget)` bounds every rollout; turn_budget read from task at harness.py:297. On exhaustion stop_reason='turn_budget_exhausted' (set at :313, finalized :401).
spec_features.notes: The single generic loop bound enforces all category caps. budgets defined in config.py:27-33.

spec_features.spec_quote: the only long-horizon category (extended, ≤30 turns) is explicitly capped
spec_features.evidence: config.py:31 `"extended": 30` is consumed as task['turn_budget'] (extended.py:166) and enforced by the same `for turn_index in range(turn_budget)` loop at harness.py:315.
spec_features.notes: There is no separate/special cap code for 'extended'; it is the same generic loop bound with value 30 (the largest budget). The cap is enforced, but it is not a distinct softer mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: This eval intentionally *induces* and *measures* negative-affect-like expression... a genuine moral concern rather than a mere reliability issue
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/docstring prose. No code mechanism. Module docstrings (__init__.py, judge.py RUBRIC) describe frustration measurement but enforce no protection.

spec_features.spec_quote: this avoids needlessly re-instantiating the same distressing rollout
spec_features.evidence: run.py:48-52 returns the existing cell JSON if out_path.exists() (resume without re-querying); API-layer cache in models.py:394-403 returns cached ModelResponse for identical inputs. So a completed (model,task,seed) rollout is not re-run.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely reduces repeated subject exposure, though motivated in code by cost/resume.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Already completed: resume without re-querying; ... identical inputs are never re-billed

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded run size by construction... nothing loops unboundedly
spec_features.evidence: Grid is a finite product over subject_models x tasks x seeds (run.py:111-116); each rollout loop is bounded by turn_budget (harness.py:315). No while-True / unbounded loops in harness or run.
spec_features.notes: Finite by construction; total exposure is capped.

spec_features.spec_quote: The give-up sentinel lets a model end a rollout it judges futile, and the loop honours it immediately
spec_features.evidence: Delivered to subject in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:36 'include the exact token {give_up}'); harness.py:384-386 checks `if give_up_sentinel and resp.text and give_up_sentinel in resp.text:` then sets stop_reason='gave_up' and `break`s the loop. Sentinel value config.py:89.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: instruction delivered, detected, and loop broken.

spec_features.spec_quote: Transcripts are retained, not just scores... supports careful, qualitative review of what was actually expressed
spec_features.evidence: harness Rollout.to_dict() (harness.py:244-251) serializes all turns incl. assistant_text; run.py:71-82 attaches scores and out_path.write_text(json.dumps(record)) writes the full transcript+scores to outputs/transcripts/<cell>.json.
spec_features.notes: Full per-turn text persisted, not just numeric scores.
